title: 中英文界面与清晰预览
changes: 编辑器新增简体中文和英文界面，默认跟随系统语言，也可手动切换并记住选择。
语言切换即时生效，保留未保存编辑、会话与工作区；菜单预览语言独立设置。
补齐 Agent、导入导出、回退、更新及系统对话框的英文文本。
修复缩放时中文笔画被舍入丢失的问题，并对齐画布与屏幕像素。
同步更新中英文图文手册与教程示例。
changesEn: The editor now supports Simplified Chinese and English, follows the system by default, and remembers a manual choice.
Switch instantly without losing unsaved edits, sessions or workspace state. Menu preview language remains independent.
Localized Agent, import/export, restore, updates and native dialogs.
Fixed missing Chinese strokes at small zoom levels and aligned the canvas with device pixels.
Updated the illustrated Chinese and English guides and tutorial examples.
